paper_navigation_metric_definition: NT and PL are mean simulated time and Gazebo truth path length over successful episodes only; both are null when there are no successes. mean_time_s and mean_path_m retain all-outcome means.
paper_metric_definition: ITR is the unweighted mean across episodes of each episode fraction whose robot center intrudes into any human ground-truth position from t+1 through t+5; SD is the pooled mean current-time closest-human center distance over intrusion timesteps.
